fix_round.summary: Sprint B fix round for G2-01, G2-02, G2-03, SEC2-01, SEC2-02 and the dev2 part of SEC2-03. Floor guard: an unpriced currency (EUR) or a foreign product is refused for non-owners, a draft's currency change re-runs the guard, fn_quote_send re-derives floor, GST and amount from the current price list, and draft edits are saved by one invoker RPC so the order of steps can no longer leave a stale floor. Buyers / buyer_contacts writes now need the owner, accountant or sales role (Plant reads only). samples, quotations, quotation_items, buyer_contacts and price_list_items may point only at parents in their own org. fn_assign_code / fn_assign_doc_no replace any code a web session supplies. All checks green except typecheck / in-repo next build, which fail only on QA's docs/qa/sprint-b/gate-2-evidence/labelcheck.ts.

findings.how: 0005 fn_quote_item_guard: no active price row for (product, quote currency) -> below_floor_price DETAIL 'no_price' for non-owners. New AFTER UPDATE OF currency trigger trg_quotations_currency_recheck (invoker fn_quotation_currency_recheck) re-runs the guard on the draft's items. fn_quote_send first runs UPDATE quotation_items SET updated_at = now() so the guard re-derives floor / GST / amount for the current currency and price list. quote-form offers only currencies priced for every picked product (pricedCurrencies), shows 'No price in EUR - owner only' on the item and blocks Save for non-owners.

contract_deviations: New function fn_quote_update_draft(p_id, p_buyer_id, p_inquiry_id, p_currency, p_fx_rate, p_incoterm, p_valid_till, p_payment_terms, p_notes, p_items jsonb) RETURNS text (quote_no), not in contracts 4.3. It is SECURITY INVOKER (RLS, column grants and the item guard apply as the caller), so it is not on the definer allowlist. updateQuoteAction uses it instead of header update + item insert/delete.
New trigger trg_quotations_currency_recheck (AFTER UPDATE OF currency, WHEN changed) -> fn_quotation_currency_recheck() (SECURITY INVOKER), not in contracts 3.4.

fn_quote_item_guard (contracts 3.5): with no price row the floor stays NULL, but a non-owner web caller gets below_floor_price DETAIL 'no_price' (contract guarded only when the floor is NOT NULL); the product must belong to the quote's org (bad_payload DETAIL 'product_id').

fn_quote_send (contracts 4.3): re-runs the item guard first, so the floor / GST / amount checked are the current price list's for the current currency (contract compared rate with the stored floor_price_at_time).

fn_assign_code / fn_assign_doc_no (contracts 2.4 / A5 'fills when NULL'): a code supplied by authenticated / anon / authenticator is replaced by the generated one; only trusted callers keep explicit codes.

0003 8a (extends amendment A1): buyers / buyer_contacts writes need fn_user_role() IN (owner, accountant, sales); buyer_contacts.buyer_id and price_list_items.product_id must be in the caller's org. Suggest the lead records this as amendment A6 in contracts.md section 11 (not dev2's file).

Only the owner can save this.', and the owner sees an amber 'Saving as owner' note.
Edit a draft and switch USD <-> INR with matching rates: it saves in one go. If a rate is below the new floor, the draft stays exactly as it was (header and items).
Mark sent re-checks against the current price list. If the floor was raised after the draft was saved, sales now gets the below-floor message on send.
